$comment: Copy to fixer.config.json at the TARGET repo root (or .fixer/config.json, or point FIXER_CONFIG at it). Every key is optional; env vars FIXER_* override. See plugins/issue-fixer/scripts/lib/config.mjs for the resolution order.

worktree.$comment: mode: worktree (default) | in-place. in-place edits directly on inPlaceBranch (or the current branch) in the main checkout — for very large repos where a second checkout is too expensive.

tracker.$comment: type: none | lark-base. 'none' = direct-evidence only, no record reads/writes. status: open/claimed/done/fixed are required; any extra keys (here notFixing, duplicate, needInfo) are the status choices offered at gate ③ for no-code-change outcomes — keep only the ones the table's status field really has (init-scratch creates every value as an option).

forge.$comment: type: git | github | custom. github (recommended) = gh pr create + dedup/update by head branch + `mr.mjs checks` CI follow-up via gh pr checks; needs `gh auth login`. repo is optional — auto-detected from the origin remote when empty. git = push branch, report MR/PR instructions (no fake success). custom = mrCommand template with {repo} {head} {base} {title} {bodyFile} {draft}.

notify.$comment: type: stdout | lark | cognia. lark sends via connector when deployed, lark-cli card locally; openId may stay empty (falls back to `lark-cli whoami`) or be a name/email (resolved via contact +search-user); chatId (oc_…) sends the card to a group instead. cognia delivers markdown through the host's connector_send command plane (session via host.sessionId or COGNIA_SESSION_ID). Scratch target never messages the real reporter.

host.$comment: type: none | cognia. The Cognia host plane (lib/cognia.mjs) — shared by notify.type=cognia, opt-in progress.push, and the integrations/cognia bot kit. cogniaBin falls back to PATH then <repoDir>/cli/dist/cognia-agent.mjs; sessionId auto-fills from COGNIA_SESSION_ID inside a host session; auth via saved host or COGNIA_ENDPOINT + COGNIA_SERVICE_TOKEN.

report.$comment: type: markdown | lark-docx | custom. markdown writes the report file and returns its path; lark-docx publishes via lark-cli; custom runs publishCommand printing a URL.

verify.$comment: Repo-specific commands, run inside the fix worktree. Empty = orchestrator infers from package.json.

deploy.$comment: Optional. Empty = deploy step is not-applicable; pipeline reports honestly.

repoRules: Example: every new component needs a co-located unit test
Example: user-facing strings must go through the repo i18n pipeline
Example: user-facing changes require a changeset entry
